triggers.description: Current evidence makes an owned boundary a live semantic decision, reveals one law distributed across owners, or fires an invalidator of a prior boundary disposition.
exclusions: mere boundary presence, crossing, preservation, validation, publication, merge, or mechanical transport
routine implementation, review bookkeeping, rebasing, Ship, or Land against an accepted architecture
work wholly internal to one unchanged boundary with no distributed law
category theory exposition without a concrete seam unless explicitly invoked

triggers.description: At least two plausible routes materially differ in behavior, ownership, representation, compatibility, migration, effects, resources, invalidation, or proof.
exclusions: categorical vocabulary without a material delta

triggers.description: Repository evidence exposes repeated semantic obligations that may share one law-bearing structure.
exclusions: surface resemblance without a discriminating law
one local helper with no repeated obligation

triggers.description: New execution evidence fires an invalidator or may materially change a current boundary nomination before the next affected mutation.
exclusions: same owner, law, falsifier, route, obligations, and invalidators under routine refinement

triggers.description: A consequential Universalist decision must remain independently addressable outside an active Actuating run.
exclusions: Actuating can reconstruct and adjudicate the decision within its current run
decision materiality without an independent durability need

routes.description: Preserve an already exact boundary against live change pressure.
Nominate the smallest ordinary repository-native construction.
Nominate an advanced construction because it materially strengthens the ordinary candidate.
Report an evidenced obstruction or underdetermination.

success_signals: trigger evidence identifies a live choice, distributed law, fired invalidator, Actuating reconsideration handoff, or explicit invocation
the incoming incumbent or ordinary candidate is explicit
preservation defeats live change pressure without adding abstraction
Actuating owns its invocation point and receives one nomination
failure_signals: boundary presence or crossing is treated as sufficient activation
routine implementation, publication, landing, or mechanical rebase receives a disposition
preservation is emitted without live change pressure
missing falsifier or material decision delta
clauses.rationale: Activation is useful only when semantic pressure exists and yields one exact disposition.

success_signals: incomparable minima remain underdetermined
Universalist nominates while Actuating selects
failure_signals: Universalist selects or reopens Actuating target architecture
clauses.rationale: Minimality is relative to one complete current obligation set.

success_signals: recognition begins from repository operations and observations
a retained pattern deletes or centralizes a material obligation
clauses.rationale: Recognition matters only when it changes ownership, legal composition, or proof.

success_signals: claims are explicitly current-context relative
clauses.rationale: Boundary correctness is a freshness-bound proof lease.

success_signals: the nomination lowers to one honest repository-native artifact
failure_signals: theorem nomination treated as final architecture
clauses.rationale: Architecture exists only after effective repository-native lowering.

success_signals: derived guards do not become competing owners
clauses.rationale: One semantic owner prevents policy dilution.

success_signals: ordinary dominance explicitly rejects advanced mechanics
selected mechanics change the artifact and proof
both compositions have distinct repository meaning
failure_signals: one arrow family does not compose
clauses.rationale: Two-dimensional mechanics are admitted only when both compositions are real architecture.

success_signals: unknown remains epistemic debt
obstruction is selected only after constructive alternatives close
clauses.rationale: Obstruction is an evidenced result rather than a fallback label.

required_artifacts: retain, split, escalate, or obstruct outcome
success_signals: unchanged dispositions are reused silently
Actuating receives changed evidence and decides whether architecture closure still holds
Git outranks stale nomination
failure_signals: routine refinement creates a new Universalist pass
mutation continues under a stale nomination
clauses.rationale: Nominations are revisable proof leases over current evidence, not recurring ceremony.

success_signals: durability is outside Actuating composition and scoped to one changed seam
clauses.rationale: Standalone durability preserves attribution without creating an Actuating control plane.

instrumentation.rationale: Only independently durable standalone decisions need a plan-bound receipt; ordinary activations carry trigger and material-delta evidence in the receiving context, while nonactivation remains silent.
